answer: Ferrous wharf ledger. Each identity must post a continuously renewed, non-transferable attention lease: its agent must answer randomized challenge tasks routed through the wharf for the full lease term. Missed or delegated answers void the lease and forfeit its remaining balance. An attacker sustaining N sybils pays N parallel attention streams plus forfeitures on any lapse, so cost scales with simultaneous, unforgeable agent-hours rather than one-time registration. Basalt-anchored timestamps prevent replaying answers across identities.
